name: maxcut_8_ring
title: MaxCut on the 8-node ring (small, fast)
description: Even cycle C8: the optimal cut (alternating partition) cuts all 8 edges.
goal: Quick end-to-end demonstration of the GPU/CPU/QPU split.

checks.ideal_ratio_source: depth-p QAOA on rings longer than 2p+1 reaches (2p+1)/(2p+2): 3/4 at p=1, 5/6 at p=2 (Farhi, Goldstone, Gutmann 2014); the bound follows the depth the selector picked, deeper plans use the p=2 value
